title: BUSINESS INFORMATION SYSTEMS OVERVIEW
description: Introduce students to the field of information management. Topics include information systems technology, the strategic role of IT, the business applications of networks, databases and Internet technologies, and the development and implementation of information systems. Use relational database models to design a real-world case study.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 270 or 270H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 270 and BA 270H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Business Information Systems (044)
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Management (196)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Cybersecurity Management (A008)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
